components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single WhatsApp CTA; inverts on blue bands.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 54px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: var(--radius, 12px); background: var(--blue); color: var(--on-blue); font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 650; font-size: 1.0625rem; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -12px oklch(50% 0.21 262 / 0.7); transition: background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--blue-deep); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn:active { transform: none; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary action with a hairline ring.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { min-height: 54px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 650; font-size: 1.0625rem; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--line); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 220ms; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--tint); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--blue); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.description: Amber pill that states the course is paid.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 34px; padding: 0 16px; margin: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--amber); color: var(--amber-ink); font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 650; font-size: 0.9375rem; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: White 20px card with the single soft shadow, lifting on hover.

Card title

components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 24px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--bg); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(22% 0.045 265 / 0.06), 0 12px 32px -16px oklch(22% 0.045 265 / 0.18); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); }

narrative.overview:
A calm, confident course page. A near-white ground, soft blue-grey bands, and exactly one saturated blue carry the whole page; rounded cards and generous Sinhala line height do the rest. The page shows the learner's route (idea to launch) immediately and earns trust through clarity, not decoration. This is the category standard played straight, executed with care: no texture, no themed motifs, no candy colour fields, no dark-mode drama above the footer.

The system is light, spacious and phone-first. Sections alternate between white and a faint blue-grey tint; two full-bleed blue bands (mission, final) are the only moments of saturation, plus the featured card and the occasional blue panel inside a section. Amber is reserved for honesty: it marks the "paid course" disclosure and nothing else.
keyCharacteristics: White page, tint bands, one blue (signal-blue) used for actions, key cards and two bands.
Figtree with Noto Sans Sinhala fallback at normal width; weights 400 to 750; Sinhala-safe leading (1.8 body, 1.32 headings).
12px and 20px radii, one soft layered card shadow, Lucide line icons in blue-tint circles.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Saturation is spent on a single blue. Any new emphasis is a tint or a deep step of that blue, never a second hue.

rules.name: The Honest Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only where the page tells the visitor the course is paid or states a limit. It is not decoration.

rules.name: The Blue Band Rule
rules.body: Full-bleed blue is limited to the mission and final sections; other blue surfaces are contained cards or panels.

rules.name: The Sinhala Leading Rule
rules.body: Body leading is 1.8 and heading leading 1.32 or more; never tighten headings below that, since Sinhala ascenders and marks collide.

rules.name: The Lining Numerals Rule
rules.body: Numbers use lining, tabular figures (steps, calculator, figures).

rules.name: The One Soft Shadow Rule
rules.body: Cards use the single Card shadow; no hard offset or tinted-neon shadows. Cards on blue use no shadow.

dos: Do keep the page white with alternating Tint Band sections and spend saturation only on Signal Blue.
Do use 12px radius for controls and 20px for cards, with the single Card shadow.
Do set Sinhala with leading 1.8 body and at least 1.32 for headings, weight 400 to 750.
Do state paid status in Disclosure Amber wherever the CTA appears with expectations.
Do keep tap targets at least 44px and give every block below the fold a single fade-up (14px, 600ms) disabled under reduced motion.
Do put line icons in Blue Tint circles at one stroke weight.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue; amber is for disclosure only.
Don't add texture, themed motifs, illustrations or dark sections other than the footer.
Don't use condensed, display-poster or system display faces.
Don't use gradient text, hard offset shadows or glyph or emoji icons.
Don't set headings below 1.32 line height or letter-space Sinhala.
